text:
Kenzie: HelixEdge reached out for a co-marketing push: marketplace feature, a short benchmark blog, and a joint technical webinar. They want a 3-week turnaround. Can we triage owners?

Arman: I can own the marketplace listing + metadata. Need logos (SVG + PNG), a co-branded hero (1200x600), a 60s demo, and a 2-sentence blurb. Helix asked for publish window by Jun 15.

Ryan (HelixEdge): We can deliver logos and a hero by Jun 5. We can also provide a customer quote and promote the webinar in our ecosystem newsletter.

Priya: I'll lead the webinar ops and landing page. Proposed date: Tue Jun 13, 10am PT. Format: 25m demo + 20m engineering panel + 15m live Q&A. Need 2 speakers and a moderator.

Marta: I'll draft the benchmark blog. Plan: transparent methodology + two charts (latency and cost per token) comparing baseline, Redwood caching, and Redwood+HelixEdge edge routing. Want perf runs and sample prompts.

ops-bot: Marketplace readiness checklist posted in #ops-templates. Required: assets, 60s video, legal signoff, UTM tags.

Design: Can do hero and social pack. Need final headline + 3 bullets by end of week. Also can help edit the 60s clip.

Kenzie: Two priority asks from Helix: 1) a 1-page AE cheat sheet with top objections and fallback playbook, 2) lead routing that tags marketplace leads with partner and product interest.

Arman: For lead routing, propose this mapping for ops: 

```
source=partner_marketplace
partner=helixedge
campaign=helixedge_launch_jun2026
sfdc_owner=Partner_Ops_Helix
lead_queue=partners_helixedge
utm_source=helixedge_marketplace&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=helixedge_launch_jun2026
```

Marta: Draft benchmark callout idea: "up to 3x throughput improvement for short-turnaround chat with 4-bit quantized models + edge routing"  Arman, can you run the sweep and verify numbers?

Arman: I'll run perf matrix today across three configs and post results. If we can't validate "3x" we'll use conservative phrasing.

Priya: Promo cadence: announcement (2wks), reminder 1w, reminder 3d, final day, last-chance (1hr). I can own email copy + 3 social posts (announce, tech highlight, webinar CTA).

Design: Social cards + hero will be ready once we get final headline and assets. Also propose a short animated GIF (60s highlight) for social.

Ryan (HelixEdge): Helix can supply a co-branded hero, an optional 60s clip, and a customer quote. Legal wants to pre-clear any named customers.

legal-bot: Please create a legal review ticket for partner quote approvals and marketplace terms. Expect 72h SLA for review.

Kenzie: AE one-pager should include: quick pitch, top 5 objections + rebuttals, demo recording link, fallback models + mitigations, and lead qualification checklist. Who will draft?

Marta: I can draft the AE one-pager once benchmarks are final. Will include suggested rebuttals for latency/cost questions.

Arman: Small dev note: marketplace schema requires tags (model-support, latency-optimized, edge-ready). I'll draft the tag list and share.

Priya: Confirming speakers: Kenzie (product), Arman (integrations eng), Ryan (HelixEdge lead). That covers product, infra, and partner voice. Need a moderator. Any volunteers?

Design: I can moderate if needed. Have hosted these before.

Kenzie: Good. Action log: 
- Arman: marketplace listing + perf validation (owner)
- Marta: benchmark blog + AE one-pager (owner)
- Priya: webinar ops + landing page + promo (owner)
- Design: hero + social + video edit + possible moderator (owner)
- Ryan (HelixEdge): partner assets + quote + newsletter amp (partner)

Kenzie: Please post blockers here. Also we should standardize the tracking pixel + webinar UTM across all partner materials. If no blockers, I'll open a timeline doc and ping Legal. :rocket:
